limits.value: the tracker records 20,000 GB a month for this configuration; the vendor prints no figure and instead applies a Fair Use Policy under which 'sustained, disproportionate traffic may have its network speed temporarily reduced'. The port is 10 Gbps shared, so shaping, not a byte count, is what a heavy month meets.
